items.name: Almonds
items.preparation: raw or dry-roasted, whole, unsalted, with skin

scale_cues: Square white plate about 23–25 cm wide, the grapes' size compared with the plate (about 2 cm long each), and counts of items (about 17 grapes and about 30 almonds)
assumptions: The small round red items are red grapes, not cherry tomatoes. They look glossy and oval with no stems.
Each grape weighs about 5 g and each almond about 1.2 g
The almonds have no added oil or salt
Some grapes or almonds underneath the pile may be hidden from view
